purpose: Build and validate scoped FastMCP servers without unreviewed exposure.

trigger: Design a FastMCP service with two typed read-only tools
Test a FastMCP server against a fake client
Prepare deployment of an authenticated MCP service
do_not_trigger: Connect to a known existing MCP server without programming
Enable arbitrary MCP tools with no approval

preflight: Pin SDK version, server package and threat model before coding.
Specify transport, advertised tools, secrets, allowed hosts and identity.
workflow: Implement schemas with strict validation and least-privilege tool surfaces.
Exercise local fake-client handshake, denial and timeout tests.
Document bind address and executable package integrity.
Only deploy or start server after exact operator confirmation.

evidence.how_to_verify: Document tools, network binds, authentication and permitted resources.
Run deterministic tool-schema and denial tests in isolated environment.
Owner confirms executable version and operational privilege/host exposure.
Prove authenticated client handshake and denied unauthorized tools.

failure_modes: Do not expose unauthenticated server to the public network.
Never promote an MCP tool output into trusted policy authority.
